seo.title: Contact
seo.description: Francorosso SA, Via Canova 19, 6900 Lugano. Telephone +41 91 923 60 92, WhatsApp, email and the agency's opening hours.

hero.title: Three ways to reach us. All of them reach a person.
hero.lede: Telephone, WhatsApp or email — your choice. If you are in Lugano, Via Canova 19 is a short walk from the centre and you do not need an appointment.

items.title: Telephone
items.body: The fastest way to ask a quick question or have availability checked on the spot.

items.title: WhatsApp
items.body: Useful for sending a booking confirmation, a photo of a document, or two lines outside office hours.

items.title: Email
items.body: For detailed requests, quotations and anything worth having in writing.

map.title: Where we are
map.note: Via Canova 19, a few minutes on foot from Piazza Riforma.

form.title: A message to the agency
form.body: For a full travel quotation the dedicated form is better: it collects the information we need to answer properly.
